stages.name: S1 Pre-activation covariance readout: var and C_off, with the VAR/COFF (and MU) oracles
stages.lines: Old 1332-1338 (C_pre = (W C) W^T on the V29 family; at the trimmed last layer var = rowsum((W C) o W)), 1362-1366, oracle 1367-1376. All line numbers here are for the 2324-line file the task cites; it has the same content as /home/user/thehonesttorus.github.io/notes/omitted-classes/code/est_v40.py. The k3work est_v29.py was edited at 03:35 UTC today (V41 audit), which adds 4 lines after line 418 and 10 after old line 1037, so the WK slices now start at 1371.
stages.inputs: C, the covariance of y_(l-1): K11 off the diagonal and K2v on it, carried in the newborn's P slot legs['AP0'][k_b,1] (old 1948). W = w32^T.
stages.outputs: var = max(diag C_pre, 1e-10) and C_off = zero_diag(C_pre). C_off is None at the trimmed last layer.
stages.approximation: [exact] A linear transport. Only f32 and Strassen rounding enter; the fentry representation route N^z is 0.1% of dC^z (share +0.002 on net 1). Its input C^y is the pair program's output, which matches the MC cov_y to <=1.4% in one step.
stages.observable_in_dumps: var_l and C_off_l are in the free-running dumps chain_off{net}_fk_*.npz, and in the one-step dumps as truth after replacement. varown_l and C_offown_l hold the chain's own values when the VAR/COFF oracles run.
stages.exact_counterpart: MC var[l] and cov[l] from mcstats.py. In MC, |C^z - W C^y W^T| / |C^z| <= 6e-7.
stages.oracle_hook: Existing: V37_ORACLE=VAR,COFF, plus MU since V41. Since V41 the current est_v29.py also has V37_ORACLE_LAYERS to restrict them to chosen layers.

stages.name: S2 Kappa4 core input, regenerated at the end of layer l-1: harmonic trace projection g_prev, var_prev, LAM value, K4Q/KD carries
stages.lines: Old 2019-2033. It consumes K4v, K22 and K2v from the pK->K step at 1880-1935. K4_sigma and K4_vec (2034-2040) are unused on the regen path.
stages.inputs: K4v = kappa4(y_a), K22 = kappa(y_a,y_a,y_b,y_b) with zero diagonal, and K2v of y_(l-1), all from the pair program at Mehler order 2. The LAM table. For KD only: C^y, m, K3v, K21.
stages.outputs: g_prev = cA (K4v + K22 1) + cI (sum K4v + sum K22 1), i.e. P(u) with u = K4v + K22 1. var_prev = K2v. lam_prev = 0.95 LAM[l-1]. For K4Q: k22q = sym(K22) and k4q = K4v. For KD: ky_prev = (C, m, K2v, K3v, K21).
stages.approximation: [truncation + trace lift] The y-level kappa4 is cut to its pair-retained classes D(K4v) + S22(K22). The pair program has outputs (1,1), (2,1), (2,2) only, so there is no (3,1)_y slice and no (2,1,1) or (1,1,1,1) class. g_prev is the minimum-norm trace lift of the diagonal trace u: the harmonic part is dropped and the off-diagonal trace is implicitly U_ij = 0 (notes XXXII s1, XXXV s1). Closure from true z inputs: K4v 0.5-1.3% (corr 1.000), K22 6-35% (corr 0.93-0.998). Transported, both are 0.5-1.7% of the next slices. The missing (3,1)_y class has a closed form B^y (note XXXIV s3), and its transport is 1.3-2.7% of the next diagonal (cells).
stages.fitted_elements: cA = 6/(n+4) and cI = -3/((n+2)(n+4)) are fresh-He constants, not fitted. LAM[16] is an LS fit of the dense aug chain's own core (G_off ~ LAM C_off) on public P2 dumps 0-7, so it is fitted to another chain, not to MC. It is multiplied by V17_LAM_SCALE = 0.95, chosen by an 8-dump output scan.
stages.observable_in_dumps: K4v_l, K22_l and K2v_l are in the one-step dumps (oracle_one keeps them whenever an oracle is set). The free-running dumps carry only K2v (KEEP_EXTRA=pk1v,K2v,K11); they need KEEP_EXTRA=K4v,K22, plus K3v,K21 for KD. g_prev itself exists only in mod.DEBUG under V17_DEBUG=1, which oracle_one.py does not save.
stages.exact_counterpart: MC k4_y[l-1], K22_y[l-1] and K31_y[l-1] from mcstats post (the mc4 files carry these _y keys), and P(u_true).
stages.oracle_hook: None exists. Minimal new 'K4Y': just before old 2021, if _orc(li) and 'K4Y' in ORACLE, set K4v = k4_y[li] and K22 = zero_diag(sym(K22_y[li])). On the regen path nothing else reads them, so only g_prev, k22q and k4q change.

stages.name: S3 Mean-field core diagonal t_g and off-diagonal variance s_off^2
stages.lines: Old 1472 (WW = W o W), 1501 (t_g), 1504 (t_v). The frozen-lam path is 1512.
stages.inputs: g_prev, var_prev = K2v_(l-1), var = diag C_pre, W o W
stages.outputs: t_g = (W o W) g_prev and t_v = s_off^2 = var - (W o W) var_prev, both n-vectors.
stages.approximation: [mean-field] t_g is the diagonal of the transported trace core W Diag(P(u)) W^T. It is the row-sum form of the exact pair class Q/2, with Q = W^o4 K4v + 3 diag(H K22 H^T): the mean is right, but a per-neuron quenched part of 4-5% of the pair class is dropped (note XXVIII s4). [exact] s_off^2 is an identity, sum over a != b of W_ia W_ib C^y_ab, given the chain's C^y.
stages.observable_in_dumps: Not dumped, but in the production configuration (K4Q=3; no KD, K4D or WK4M) it can be rebuilt exactly from the free-running or one-step dumps: r = rowsum(wk4m_l), S = 3 sum(r)/(2(n-1)), dG = (3r - S)/(n-2) (checked to 6e-17); lam_l = <wk431_l, C_off_l>/|C_off_l|^2; t_v = var_l - H K2v_(l-1); t_g = dG - lam_l t_v.
stages.exact_counterpart: Q/2 from the MC y slices (T_pair or pair_lift with k4_y, K22_y, as in yclasses.py and cells.py). True s_off^2 = var[l] - H var_y[l-1].
stages.oracle_hook: New 'G4PAIR': after old 1520, set g4row = METRIC_C (q4half[li] + lam_prev t_v), with q4half = Q/2 precomputed per layer from MC (one n^3 product per layer, offline).

stages.name: S4 K4Q=3 quenched pair-class correction k4corr (diagonal only)
stages.inputs: k22q and k4q of y_(l-1), WW, W^o4, the sketch w32[:, :12], K4Q_RANK = 4
stages.outputs: k4corr = 0.5 W^o4 K4v - H P(K4v) + 1.5 diag(H Khat0 H^T) - H P(Khat0 1); g4row += 2 k4corr
stages.approximation: [exact up to the rank] The (4)-class reweighting is exact, and so is the transport of the Ritz part Khat0 of K22: K4Q_RANK + 8 = 12 pairs, one power iteration, a weight-slice sketch. The remainder E = K22 - Khat0 stays mean-field with its residual core at metric 2I. That remainder, -R_W(E), splits into D_metric, D_known and D_unresolved, each 0.000-0.005 of truth and uncorrelated with the residual (cells). Only g4row receives k4corr: wk4m, the lam rule's dG0 and the K4->K3 feed (dgw, u_b) all use dG without it.
stages.fitted_elements: K4Q_RANK = 4 is a choice; the gain is flat over ranks 2-16. The coefficient is 1 and nothing is fitted (raw -2.25% +- 0.19 over 100 networks).
stages.observable_in_dumps: k4corr_l = g4row_l/2 - dG_l, with dG from the wk4m inversion in S3.
stages.exact_counterpart: Q/2 - t_g at the MC y slices. The chain's own quenched part correlates 1.000 with the truth (note XXVIII).
stages.oracle_hook: Existing ablation: V33_K4Q=0. For truth, use G4PAIR (S3).

stages.name: S5 Adaptive lam: the amplitude of the stand-in for the (2+1+1) and (1+1+1+1) classes
stages.lines: Old 1499-1510 (BETA != 0, production) and 1512 (frozen). Reset to the table value at 2025.
stages.inputs: t_g, t_v, var, lam_prev = 0.95 LAM[l-1], REF_R[l-1], BETA
stages.outputs: lam_l = lam_prev clip(mean(t_g + t_v lam_prev) / mean(var) / REF_R[l-1], 0.5, 2)^BETA; dG = t_g + lam_l t_v
stages.approximation: [STAND-IN] lam_l t_v stands in for half the transported y (2,1,1) + (1,1,1,1) classes R, for the absent (3,1)_y transport, and for whatever compensation it absorbs. It is one scalar per layer times the off-diagonal variance. The scale mixture's own diagonal form is 6g s_diag^2 s_off^2 + 3g s_off^4 (note XXI), so the per-neuron s_diag^2 factor is missing. The rule compares a degree-4 mean with a degree-2 mean against a fixed table, so it is not scale-homogeneous (note XXXII s4). Any change to the pair part moves lam, and through lam all three slices and the feed.
stages.fitted_elements: LAM[16] (the aug-chain LS fit); 0.95 (output scan); REF_R[15] (an 8-dump mean of the chain's own mean(dG)/mean(var)); BETA = 1.0 (the pooled fit gave 1.08); clip to [0.5, 2]. Leverage when removed: the adaptive rule +0.3% +- 0.2; the whole stand-in +88.7%.
stages.observable_in_dumps: lam_l = <wk431_l, C_off_l>/|C_off_l|^2 exactly, in the free-running dumps as well. One-step lam per layer: 0.0074 (1->2), 0.0102-0.0104 (3->6), 0.0087 (13->14) (yclasses).
stages.exact_counterpart: There is none; this is a stand-in. The truth-optimal amplitude for the same shape is yclasses' joint LS fit of candidate A against R = t - T_pair(y), bAj: 0.0055 at 1->2 and 0.0076 at 2->3, rising to 0.0120 at 13->14. The per-slice optima at 1->2 are 0.0140 (diag), 0.0126 ((2,2)) and 0.0053 ((3,1)). The shape explains 50/33/32% of R; D explains 63/46/53%.
stages.oracle_hook: None exists. Minimal new 'LAM': after old 1509, set lam_prev = _ORACLE_DATA['lam'][li] (e.g. bAj). Two variants separate its two uses: apply it to the slices only, or to the feed's c1_b only (old 1859).

stages.name: S6 Slice assembly in production: g4row, wk4m, wk431
stages.lines: Old 1513-1520. wk431 = None at the trimmed last layer.
stages.outputs: g4row = 2(dG + k4corr) = Q - R_W(E) + 2 lam s_off^2; wk4m = zero_diag((dG_i + dG_j)/3); wk431 = lam C_off, where wk431[a,c] = kappa(z_a,z_c,z_c,z_c) = K31[c,a]
stages.approximation: Three slices, three charts (note XXXV). Diagonal: the seed chart, i.e. exact D(K4v) + B(Khat0) with the residual core at 2I, plus lam. (2,2): the pure trace core C(2I, W Diag(P(u)) W^T), plus lam. It has no Ritz seed, no 4 M_ij N_ij term and no 2 c^T K c cross term. (3,1) [PURE STAND-IN]: the lam constituent alone. It has no pair part ((H(3 K22 + diag K4v)) o W) W^T, no trace-core term (W Diag(P(u)) W^T)_ac, no B^y and no D21 dependence. The lam terms of the diagonal and (2,2) use W C^y_off W^T; the (3,1) slice uses the full C^z_off. The metric M = W W^T is replaced by 2I. Representation effects are negligible: chain, c00, c10 and c01 differ by <=0.003 on the diagonal and (2,2), and adding B^y (c6) gains 0.003-0.006. The one-step error is the omitted classes net of the lam core (yclasses). Closure is 0.5-1.7%. Representation is 1.4-3.8% on the diagonal and 0.22-0.51 on (3,1). The omitted classes net of lam make up nearly all the rest.
stages.fitted_elements: METRIC_C = 2 (an annealed He constant), and lam from S5.
stages.observable_in_dumps: g4row_l, wk4m_l and wk431_l (free-running; in the oracle dumps they hold the truth after replacement). g4rowown_l, wk4mown_l and wk431own_l hold the chain's one-step slices from true inputs.
stages.exact_counterpart: MC k4[l], K22[l] and K31[l]^T. One-step error from true inputs (kdcmp): diag 0.131-0.288, (2,2) 0.144-0.292, (3,1) 0.73-0.87. Free-running (kd_free): g4row 0.132-0.363, wk4m 0.145-0.324, (3,1) 0.74-0.81. The ratio of one-step to free-running error energy is 0.83-1.0 at every layer, so this error is created at each layer, not inherited.
stages.oracle_hook: Existing: V37_ORACLE=G4,WK4M,K31 (old 1632-1641), with V37_ORACLE_LAYERS in the current est_v29.py. Minimal new subtractive variant ('G4C', 'WK4MC', 'K31C'): at the chosen layers, subtract the stored one-step created error (own - truth, a per-layer key in the oracle npz) instead of replacing the slice. This telescopes creation alone, leaving the propagated part, in the free-running chain.

stages.name: S7 K4->K3 birth feed (F68): the lam core written into each newborn kappa3 source
stages.lines: Old 1850-1876 (X3, Y3, M_t1 and the birth dslices); 1877-1878 (rep21); 1949-1952 (subtracted into S3c and S21); 1988-1998 (u_b and y_b as Z columns r and r+1, w1^2 as L column r); 2016-2018 (the c1, c2, y lists); _dslices 2234-2259 and 2291-2306 (transported readout). The current est_v29.py adds 10 to each.
stages.inputs: w1 = Phi and w2 = rho from W_all at layer l; dG from S5 (no k4corr); lam_l from S5; the A leg a_b = d(w1) C_off; METRIC_C.
stages.outputs: The hub X3 = A c1 + P c2 = d(w1)[diag(dG) + lam C_off] d(w1), with static c1 = lam w1 and c2 = w1^2 dG. Y3 = y 1^T with y = (METRIC_C/4) w2 = rho/2, transported as Z column r+1. The thin M-type term M_t1 = u v^T with u = y dG and v = w1^2. Birth pieces go into D21_new and D3_new. At later layers the readout adds D3 += y rowsum(X3 o P) and D21 += (1/3) R y^T + (2/3)(y o X3) P^T.
stages.approximation: [exact gate coefficient on a STAND-IN input] The net y-level content is the all-distinct class only: T_abc = (lam/6) sum_cyc rho_a Phi_b Phi_c C^z_bc. This is the exact first-order (2,1,1)->(1,1,1) gated transport (note XXXIV: omega = V/2 times c(1,2) c(1,1) c(1,1)) applied to the declared z entries V_a;bc = (lam/3) C^z_bc. Those entries are the lam constituent of J(2I, lam W C^y W^T), the same constituent as wk431. The diagonal and (2,1) pieces (the dG terms and M_t1) are bookkeeping: they are subtracted into S3c and S21, so the y-level D3 and D21 stay pinned to K3v and K21 up to the rank-4 residual leg. The pieces and the theorem identity were checked to 1e-17 on a 7-neuron tensor (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thehonesttorus-github-io/2cab30f0-c454-5769-8d9a-8195cd80a5f3/scratchpad/stagemap/check.py). For a scale mixture the true V is g(var_a C_bc + 2 C_ab C_ac), plus Cov(r,r^3) mean terms, plus the transported pair classes. The chain lacks the per-neuron var_a factor, the C_ab C_ac term, the mean terms and (W Diag(P(u)) W^T)_bc. The legs then carry the content with first-order gating (exact, note XXXVI s3c), so a per-layer kappa4 stand-in error becomes an inherited kappa3 error.
stages.fitted_elements: lam, and through it LAM, REF_R and BETA; METRIC_C.
stages.observable_in_dumps: D21_new_l, rep21_l, S3c_l, Rres_l, w1_l and w2_l are DUMPS keys and need KEEP_EXTRA. D21_new mixes the facet, the feedback and the feed. The feed's all-distinct content is not dumped, but it can be rebuilt from lam_l (wk431 against C_off), C_off_l, w1 and w2. Its next-layer D3 contribution is (lam/2) sum_a (W' o rho)_ia [(X C_off X^T)_ii - 2 X_ia (C_off X^T)_ai] with X = W' o Phi, one n^3 product.
stages.exact_counterpart: The first-order K4-fed part of the all-distinct y class, 0.5 sum_cyc rho_a Phi_b Phi_c kappa(z_a,z_a,z_b,z_c). It is inside rem = R3 - leg1 - facet, but it is not among k3rem.py's candidates (GC1, GC2, DS, TRI). No current accumulator measures it: mcstats has no (2,1,1) z entries, and mclegs has only kappa3 contractions. Minimal MC: in mclegs.py add Q[l] += (D*D) @ U2.T, i.e. E[d_a^2 U_i^2]. Then kq = Q - var_a (X C X^T)_ii - 2 (C X^T)_ai^2 - X_ia^2 k4_a - 2 X_ia (K31_off X^T)_ai - (K22_off (X o X)^T)_ai, and D3_K4F_i = 1.5 sum_a W'_ia rho_a kq[a,i]. Add this to k3rem.py as candidate 'K4F'. A cheaper proxy with existing data is the radial-tangent V built from MC truth at the KD_G amplitude.
stages.oracle_hook: Existing: the global kill switch V17_NO_FEED=1 (+4.3% raw in the system audit). It also moves the feed's full-rank D21 birth piece (2/3) y o X3_off into the rank-4 residual leg, so it conflates two effects. Minimal new: a per-layer 'FEED0' through _orc(li) at old 1850, a feed-only lam for c1_b read from the oracle file, or a V-model swap (y_b times var/mean(var) for the mixture's var_a factor). The all-oracle runs never replace the feed, because dG and lam are formed before the replacements at old 1632-1641.

stages.name: S8 V39 KD: a G.D core in place of lam (not production)
stages.inputs: ky_prev = (C^y, m, var_y, K3v, K21) of y_(l-1); var, C_off, mu, D3 and D21 of z_l; WW and W; g_prev and k4corr; KD_G[l-1].
stages.outputs: Bit 1: g4row = 2(t_g + k4corr) + G(D_diag - Tpair_diag). Bit 2: wk4m = (t_g,i + t_g,j)/3 + G(D22 - Tpair22). Bit 4: wk431 = [G(D31 - Tpair31)]^T.
stages.approximation: [derived shape, fitted amplitude] D is the radial tangent GS Sym3(Sigma,Sigma) + GM Sym4(mu,kappa3) at z, minus the exact transport of its own pair-supported y part (six n^3 products). The pair parts keep their charts: the seed chart on the diagonal, the trace core (now without lam) on (2,2), and no pair part on (3,1). The lam rule and the K4->K3 feed still run on lam (S5, S7). KD also does not act at the last layer: the guard requires 'not trim' and 'D21 is not None', and both fail there. So z_15's g4row is the lam core in KD runs: the free-running KD and production errors at layer 15 correlate +1.00 (0.334 vs 0.363), against +0.59 at layer 14.
stages.fitted_elements: KD_G[15] = yclasses' joint D coefficient on MC network 1 (0.196 for transition 0->1, 2.061 for 1->2, ..., 4.72), indexed KD_G[l-1] at layer l. README s3h says 'layer 1 -> 2 uses 0.20', which is one transition off from the code. KD_AMP. GS = 2/n and GM = Cov(r, r^3) are exact.
stages.observable_in_dumps: The chain_off{net}_fk_kd.npz slices. There wk431 = G D31 exactly. Separating D on the diagonal or on (2,2) needs K4v and K22 of layer l-1 (KEEP_EXTRA).
stages.exact_counterpart: R from yclasses. D explains 63/46/53% over layers 2-14; one-step diagonal error goes from 0.27-0.29 to 0.19-0.21.
stages.oracle_hook: Existing: V39_KD, V39_KD_BITS, V39_KD_AMP. Output +8.6% (net 1) and +10.4% (net 0); every bit subset is worse. Its own K31 route grows by +5.0/+2.6 and its own kappa4 route by +1.9/+2.3, in % of n MSE.

stages.name: S9 Variants with derived core shapes (not production): V38 K4D=3/4, V31 K4D=1/2, V30 K4SM, V33 WK4M and ABL_WK4M
stages.inputs: WW, g_prev, k4corr, var, var_prev, lam_prev, mix_prev (gains read from z_(l-1)'s g4row or D3), D3, mu, C_off, g4row
stages.outputs: V38: g4row only, = 2(t_g + k4corr) + g(6 s_diag^2 s_off^2 + 3 s_off^4). V31: dG = t_g + lam_i s_off^2 with lam_i proportional to 3 s_diag^2 + 1.5 s_off^2, in all slices. K4SM 1/2/4: the whole sector from one mixture gain g (an LS fit of D3 on 1.5 mu var): g4row = 3g var^2, wk4m = g var_i var_j, wk431[a,c] = 3g var_c C_ac; K4SM 2 also adds -(g/8) mu (Phi - alpha phi) to the mean. K4SM 3: only the (3,1) slice, from the diagonal's implied gain. WK4M 1/2/3: mixture (2,2) shapes. ABL_WK4M zeroes wk4m.
stages.approximation: [stand-ins with derived shapes] These are closed forms from the scale mixture. In the gain projection the mixture's (2+1+1) term matches the measured class to 10-25% (note XXI s3-5). The amplitudes come from the chain's own D3 or g4. K4SM 1/2/4 drop the pair-class transport entirely, and none of these variants carries per-neuron C^2 content beyond the mixture's.
stages.fitted_elements: K4D_AMP and K4SM_AMP (1.0); K4SM_RATIO[16], the MC-measured g4/g3 on networks 0 and 1.
stages.observable_in_dumps: The slice keys of S6. The mixture gains are not dumped.
stages.exact_counterpart: R and t (yclasses, mcstats), and the k4classes power-sum classes.
stages.oracle_hook: The switches themselves. Recorded outcomes: V31 derived amplitude +49.5%, fitted amplitude with derived shape +9.4%, half amplitude +13.6% (better on 0/16 networks). K4SM=1 is about 10x worse (net 0: 2.20e-7 against 2.18e-8). K4SM=2 diverges (5.4e-4). K4SM=4 +12.5%. K4SM=3 at amplitude 0.8: -2.5% on net 0 and +1.1% on net 1. WK4M 1/2/3: +4.8%, +12.1%, -0.6%. ABL_WK4M +1539%. I found no recorded result for V38 in the notes.

stages.name: S10 Kappa3 readouts within the section: D3 and D21 from the legs (inputs to the pair program and to the KD, K4SM and K4D gains)
stages.lines: Old 1416-1460: the _dslices call at 1434-1442, SAT masks at 1443-1448, the D3/D21 oracle at 1449-1460. The SAT and BIRTH_SAT masks at 1377-1402 are inactive in the analysed configuration (V33_SAT is unset in oracle_one's _prod).
stages.inputs: The A, P, Z, L and Zf legs of every live source; the w2b, s, e, c1, c2 and y lists; the shared-basis factors.
stages.outputs: D3 (n-vector) and D21 (n x n, zero diagonal; None at the last layer).
stages.approximation: [exact first-order transport of what the births contain] This reads the first-order gated transport of every birth: the facet hub B1, the D21 feedback at half the theorem's weight, the K4 feed (S7), and the M-leg residual at rank 4. The R3 law (legs + facet) is exact to 99.1-99.4%. The chain's legs error, 11-19% of R3, is the law's remainder born at each birth (dominated by GC1) and then carried. Compression accounts for <=6% of it.
stages.fitted_elements: None in the readout itself. FB_SX = FB_SY = 1 are the V18 weights; R_RES = 4, R_FB = 2 and R_OLD = 320/192 are ranks.
stages.observable_in_dumps: D3_l and D21_l (free-running); D3own_l and D21own_l (one-step); the legs through V30_DUMP_LEGS.
stages.exact_counterpart: MC k3[l] and D21[l]; R3 from mcstats post together with the mclegs accumulators (u3, P, S).
stages.oracle_hook: Existing: V37_ORACLE=D3,D21, with V37_ORACLE_LAYERS. It replaces the readouts only, never the legs, so the births keep the chain's own content and D3own is not pure creation.

stages.name: S11 Use side: the Edgeworth mean and the pair program read g4row, wk4m and wk431
stages.lines: Old 1650-1742 (the W_all wick weights and the fused term programs); TERM_SPECS at 201-262 and the four wk431 terms at 339-342; pK->K at 1880-1935; assembly at 1937-1948
stages.inputs: mu, var, C_off, D3, D21, g4row, wk4m, wk431
stages.outputs: pk1v (the mean of y_l), K2v, K3v, K4v, K11, K21, K22
stages.approximation: [Gaussian-reference closure, adequate] The mean is Gauss + D3/6 E relu''' + g4/24 E relu'''' + D3^2/72 E relu^(6) + D3 g4/144 E relu^(7). The pair programs run at Mehler order 2, pruned at relative contribution 1e-5. The first-order read directions, which are fentry's routes: kappa4 diagonal to m with c4 = (alpha^2 - 1) phi/(24 sigma^3), to var_y with q4 - 2m c4, and to C^y with f4 Phi C. wk4m to C^y with (dK/4) rho_a rho_b. wk431 to C^y with (dB/6)(c13_a Phi_b + Phi_a c13_b). With true inputs the map leaves 2% of the non-Gaussian part of each query (kquery), and the covariance response is reproduced to 2-3% (covroute).

key_findings: The kappa4 slices are created afresh at every layer, at the lam stand-in (old lines 1499-1520). Nothing carries them between layers: g4row, wk4m and wk431 at z_l are rebuilt from the y_(l-1) pair slices (K4v and K22 into g_prev, k22q, k4q; old 2019-2033) plus one scalar times s_off^2 or C_off. From TRUE inputs, the one-step slices already hold 0.83-1.0 of the free-running error energy at every layer: diagonal 0.137, 0.206, 0.288 one-step against 0.137, 0.217, 0.315 free-running at z_2, z_10, z_14; (2,2) 0.292 against 0.324 at z_14; (3,1) 0.73-0.87 against 0.74-0.81. Every exactly transported constituent (C_pre, s_off^2, the (4)-class and rank-12 Ritz pair class, the 2I metric) moves the slices by <=0.003 (cells), and the pair-program closure transports to 0.5-1.7%. What is created is the omitted y classes (2,1,1) + (1,1,1,1) net of the lam core. It grows with depth as |R|/|t| rises: 0.14 to 0.48 on the diagonal, 0.15 to 0.41 on (2,2), 0.80 to 0.97 on (3,1). So the first entries fentry assigns to the kappa4 diagonal (0.24-0.28 of |e|^2, entering at layers 8-15) and to K31 (0.17-0.19, from layer 8) are created at the layer where they enter.

The only free parameter at that creation site was never fitted to what it replaces. LAM is an LS fit of the dense aug chain's own core, times 0.95 from an output scan, modulated by a REF_R table of the chain's own mean(dG)/mean(var) with BETA = 1. Against Monte Carlo, the one-step lam is 0.0074 at 1->2, peaks at 0.0104 at 4->5 and falls to 0.0087 at 13->14. The truth-optimal amplitude for its own shape (bAj) is 0.0055 at 1->2 and 0.0076 at 2->3, rising to 0.0120. So the chain is 1.2-1.3x too large in the first transitions and 0.73x at depth. The per-slice optima disagree at shallow depth (1->2: diagonal 0.0140, (3,1) 0.0053). Most of the created error is shape: at 13->14 the optimal amplitude would leave 0.264 of the diagonal against the chain's 0.282, while D at its fitted amplitude leaves 0.195. L2 is still not the readout metric: KD cut that error and its own K31 and kappa4 output images grew.

The K4->K3 birth feed (old 1850-1878, carried by _dslices old 2234-2259 and 2291-2306) is the one place where the memoryless kappa4 stand-in turns into inherited state. Each newborn kappa3 source gets X3_off = lam d(Phi) C^z_off d(Phi) and Y3 = rho/2. Its only net content is the all-distinct class (lam/6) sum_cyc rho_a Phi_b Phi_c C^z_bc; the dG and M_t1 pieces cancel against S3c and S21 (checked to 1e-17). That is the exact first-order gate coefficient applied to stand-in z entries V = (lam/3) C^z_bc, which lack the mixture's per-neuron var_a, its 2 C_ab C_ac term, the Cov(r,r^3) mean terms and the trace-core part. The legs then carry it into every later D3 and D21. Its true counterpart, 0.5 sum_cyc rho_a Phi_b Phi_c kappa(z_a,z_a,z_b,z_c), lies inside the kappa3-law remainder. It is not a candidate in k3rem.py and no accumulator measures it; one n x n accumulator, E[d_a^2 U_i^2], added to mclegs.py would. The all-oracle runs never replace the feed, and under KD it stays on lam. KD therefore changes the kappa4 slices the readouts use without changing the kappa4 content written into the kappa3 legs, and the adverse pair that recurs in the ledger is kappa3-kappa4.

The current diagnostics cannot separate created error from inherited error. fentry's state is (m, C) only, so a cumulant-state error is entered at the layer where it is read, whenever it was made. The all-oracle D3own and D21own still contain every earlier birth: the current-layer remainder explains 50% of the legs error at layer 1 and only 18-25% at depth. Only the kappa4 own - truth is pure creation. Since 03:35 UTC today, the k3work est_v29.py carries a V41 audit (V37_ORACLE_LAYERS plus an MU oracle; lines shift by +4 after 418 and +10 after old 1037), so per-layer replacement already exists. The cleanest creation-only telescope is subtractive: at chosen layers, remove the stored one-step created error (g4rowown - k4, wk4mown - K22, wk431own - K31^T) from the free-running slices, instead of replacing them with truth.

KD's measured output change (+8.6% net 1, +10.4% net 0) was taken with the lam stand-in still active at the most-read layer. Its guard at old 1530 needs 'not trim' and 'D21 is not None', and both fail at the last layer. So z_15's g4row, which carries the largest single kappa4 first entry (+5.4% of |e|^2 on net 1), is the lam core in KD runs: the KD and production free-running g4row errors at layer 15 correlate +1.00 (0.334 vs 0.363), against +0.59 at layer 14. The feed is also still on lam at every layer.

Every internal of the production kappa4 stage can be rebuilt exactly from the existing free-running dumps, with no new run. lam_l = <wk431_l, C_off_l>/|C_off_l|^2. dG_l = (3r - S)/(n-2) with r = rowsum(wk4m_l) and S = 3 sum(r)/(2(n-1)). t_v = var_l - (W o W) K2v_(l-1), t_g = dG - lam_l t_v, and k4corr = g4row_l/2 - dG. So the free-running stand-in part (2 lam t_v on the diagonal, (lam/3)(t_v,i + t_v,j) on (2,2), lam C_off on (3,1)), and with it the feed's input, can be compared layer by layer with its MC target R = t - T_pair(k4_y, K22_y, K31_y) from mc4. K4v and K22 are needed only to recompute g_prev, and only for KD runs (KEEP_EXTRA=K4v,K22).
